infoText.photos: Number of photos you can add to your listing.
infoText.description: Maximum word count for your listing description.
infoText.viewCount: See how many people viewed your listing each month.
infoText.verifiedBadge: A verified credential badge displayed on your listing, increasing trust with families.
infoText.analytics: Insights into how your listing is performing in search and on the platform.
infoText.reviewResponse: Respond publicly to reviews left by families on your listing.
infoText.priorityPlacement: Your listing rotates through priority positions in search results among Premium and Featured members.
infoText.featuredPlacement: Your listing rotates through featured spots on the homepage and category pages.
infoText.accountSupport: A dedicated account support representative to help you get the most from your listing.
